sourceNotes: This pass started from https://kymedcan.ky.gov/Pages/index.aspx on 2026-09-08 and stayed on kymedcan.ky.gov. That host is the Kentucky Office of Medical Cannabis. The laws page at /laws-and-regulations/Pages/default.aspx restates Senate Bill 47 and says cannabis consumption outside the medical program remains illegal. The General Questions FAQ at /FAQs/Pages/General-Questions.aspx answers that individuals may not grow their own medical cannabis and that medical cannabis is only sold at licensed dispensaries. The Patient and Caregiver FAQ states that a registered qualified patient may purchase a 30-day supply during a 25-day period. Find a Dispensary at /patients-and-caregivers/Pages/Find-a-Dispensary.aspx lists open licensed dispensaries as of August 28, 2026. The stored citations on apps.legislature.ky.gov were replaced because that host is not the requested source and this host already answers those questions. The stored home-grow sentence is no longer on the homepage. Fetch with browser headers returns 200 and the excerpts are in the HTML, so these rows do not need a browser.
